points.description: First blank: observed (data/frequencies) – the observed sample data or frequencies.
points.partial_credit: Half if vaguely stated (e.g. 'actual data' without observed/sample sense).

points.description: Second and third blanks: assumed/estimated/theoretical (fitted) probability density function (PDF/distribution).
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'assumed/estimated/theoretical' or only 'PDF/distribution' is given, not both.

rubric.notes: Full marks need 'observed' for the first blank and an assumed/estimated (theoretical, fitted) PDF or distribution for the rest. Give half of a point for a partly right or vague phrase, such as 'expected' alone or 'distribution' without saying assumed. Give no marks for unrelated answers, such as mean and variance or rainfall and runoff.
